description: Na₈Al₆Si₆O₂₄ICl crystallizes in the cubic P23 space group. There are two inequivalent Na sites. In the first Na site, Na is bonded to three equivalent O and one I atom to form distorted NaIO₃ tetrahedra that share corners with three equivalent NaIO₃ tetrahedra, corners with three equivalent AlO₄ tetrahedra, and corners with three equivalent SiO₄ tetrahedra. All Na-O bond lengths are 2.35 Å. The Na-I bond length is 3.02 Å. In the second Na site, Na is bonded to three equivalent O and one Cl atom to form distorted NaClO₃ tetrahedra that share corners with three equivalent NaClO₃ tetrahedra, corners with three equivalent AlO₄ tetrahedra, and corners with three equivalent SiO₄ tetrahedra. All Na-O bond lengths are 2.40 Å. The Na-Cl bond length is 2.90 Å. Al is bonded to four O atoms to form AlO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with four NaIO₃ tetrahedra and corners with four equivalent SiO₄ tetrahedra. All Al-O bond lengths are 1.76 Å. Si is bonded to four O atoms to form SiO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with four NaIO₃ tetrahedra and corners with four equivalent AlO₄ tetrahedra. All Si-O bond lengths are 1.64 Å. There are two inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to one Na, one Al, and one Si atom. In the second O site, O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to one Na, one Al, and one Si atom. I is bonded in a tetrahedral geometry to four equivalent Na atoms. Cl is bonded in a tetrahedral geometry to four equivalent Na atoms.
